resources.string: Back up and restore

A backup is one file with your library, reading positions, bookmarks, highlights, voice notes, pronunciation fixes, Up next, reading settings and listening stats, plus books shared into ListenLock. Keep it somewhere safe, such as Drive or a computer.\n\nVoices and the dictionary are not included: download them again on the new phone. Books opened from your phone\'s storage come back once you add the same file again, with their positions and notes; watched folders ask to be picked again.

This replaces the library, notes and settings on this phone with the ones in the backup. ListenLock restarts to finish.
